tiny_case_classifications.mixed-permuted-1000: Primary elapsed median regressed; followup reversed sign with broad spread. Direction is inconclusive.
tiny_case_classifications.mixed-overlap-1000: Repeated measured paired-median elapsed regression in primary and followup, approximately1.55ms and1.37ms. Followup only3/6 pairs slower and spread crosses zero; evidence does not isolate an algorithmic CPU cost or establish a general slowdown.
tiny_case_classifications.mixed-adjacent-1000: Primary elapsed median regressed; followup reversed sign with broad spread. Direction is inconclusive.

method_limits: Mac elapsed is high-resolution launch-to-completion time around /usr/bin/time and the CLI, including process launch and I/O.

Native user/system CPU fields are printed to0.01s resolution. Both fields printed0.00 for every measured process in these three tiny primary/followup cases; zero displayed CPU cannot establish zero cost or a CPU ratio.
All phases remain separate; no sample removed, pooled, or rerun beyond the predefined fixed followup.

The overlap1000 case retains two above5% paired medians despite mixed-sign pair spreads. Treat the measured millisecond-scale regression as retained evidence, not proof of stable library-level slowdown.
